usedFor: TallyPrime holds vouchers like receipts, and Microsoft Excel gets each one as a row through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Receipt event occurs” in TallyPrime, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each receipt recorded in Tally Prime adds a row to an Excel table.

watchOut: “New Receipt event occurs” fires on create, update or delete, so one receipt can add several rows.
